tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po'i 'phro bzhugs

so// drag po mngon spyod ces bya ba// ting 'dzin sngags rdzas 'khor lo sogs// byed tshul rnam pa mang mchis kyang*// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sgrub po rnams// ting 'dzin sgom pa mi nus shing*// gsang sngags bzlas brjod ma dag la// 'khor lo la sogs gnad 'phyug na// gzhan la mi gnod rang nyid phung*// de bas snyigs ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// kha 'dzin rgyab rten rdzas kyi cha// dam tshig ldan zhing bla sgrub la// mchog tu 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pas// me yi sbyor bas bsad pa ni// te lo'i khog pa tshang ma'i nang*// sre mo nag po'i khog pa bcug /de'i nang chu byi long ma yi// khog pa bcug la de yi nang*// bso dri can gyi sbur nag dang*// bya nag mu zi nag po dang*// bse zho nag dang tshur nag dang*/ /spu nag thang khrom nag po dang*// dbyi mong nag dang kyi lce nag /khyi nag spyang nag zhim nag gi// brun dang sha khrag la sogs dang*| |ra rog phag nag khrag la sogs// skyung kha bya rog srin bya dang*// 'ug pa'i sha khrag gang rnyed rnams// lag tshags dam par nang du ni// bsres la phye mar byas te btab// khog pa gsum po nang nas rim// kha bsum rdzas mi 'chor bar bya// thang khrom lo ma'i gseb tu bsnyal// zhag gsum lon nas ser por 'gyur// de dag phyi nang bsres la brdung*// grib skam byas la tshags byas nas// dgos dus dug tsher me la bsreg /dud pa gang phog de rnams ni// khrag dang chu ser 'dzag pa dang*// za phrug la sogs nad kyis ni// zla ba phyed nang 'gum par nges// rang srung dri chen dri chu dang*// shu kra pad raka ga pur dang*// gla rtsi rgya tshil sbyar ba dag |rang sogs gang srung lus dang ni// dbang po rnams byugs thub par nges// / rlung la bskyon nas bsad pa ni// khra dang 'ug pa bya rog dang*// bya rgod go bo skyung ka dang*// srel ba phug ron bag sogs dgu'i// nang khrol sha khrag rus par bcas// brag zhun sre mo'i brun dang ni// shan pa dme pho'i dri chen dang*// gri ro'i brun dang khyi brun dang*// te lo byi la'i brun dang ni// spang spos rgya spos sgog skya dang*// g.yer ma rgya btsong rgya ba dang*// gling dang sman mo zang rtsi ba// gza' dug rdzi dug mda' dug dang*// btsan dug bong nag ra dug dang*// khyi dug spyang dug nya dug dang*// phag dug mi mkhris khyi rta'i mkhris// dre'u bong bu mdzau rtol mkhris// rta bon ra thug bse sbre dang*// gla rtsi tang kun rna rwa'i gzhob// du ba ral ba pha ba dog

/mu zi ser po thar nu dang*/ /re lcag pa sogs bsdus pa rnams// zhib btags ra khrag gis sbrus pa// ra grod nang blug thar nu yi// 'o ma dang sbyar ra lud nang*// zhag gsum bsnyal la grib skam bya// zhib btags phye ma dgra bo'i phyogs// rlung la bskur bas phog ma thag /lto bcud mi len lus 'dar g.yo// rlung gis brgyal te 'chi bar nges// rang srung gla rtsi mu zi ser// sgog gcig ga pur shing kun dang*// ra tshil sbyar ba rang lus la// lan gsum byugs pas thub par nges// / chu la bskyon nas bsad pa ni// se bo nya dang spe ba nya// rmang ma nya dang gsum po la// gzhi byas de yi kha tshar ni// sbal pa lcong mo nye'u chung rnams// hrug gur btang la sram gyi ni// khong par blugs la de'i gseb tu// thar nu thang khrom re lcag pa// gro chang phab rul mdze pho'i khrag /gnyan pa chu mig dgu yi chu// sbrus la blug cing ro lpags gtum// thang khrom thar nu re lcag gsum/ /bsres pa'i lo ma'i gseb tu bsnyal// 'dul mor rul nas cag cig la// de tshe rang gi bsrung ba ni// gla rtsi ga pur nya mkhris gsum// sbyar ba rang gi lus la byug |rdzas rnams blangs la grib skam bya// zhib btags gang dgos dgra bo la// chu dang sbyar la gos dang mal// lham sogs gang rung byugs na yang*// reg pas chog go des gang reg |khol bur phol mig rdol nas kyang*// lus po 'dul nas 'chi bar nges// gong gi rang srung rdzas des kyang*// rdzi dang dri phyogs thub phyir yin// sha rjen reg na mi thub pas// rang gi sha la ma reg gces// / sa la bskyon nas bsad pa ni// mdze pho'i sha khrag dbang po lnga// rta bong ra khyi gri khrag dang*// ri bong sha khrag mchog tu shes// dug sbrul nya sbal nag po dang*// gang sbal rtsang nag sdig srin dang*// sdom sdig lcong mo phye leb dang*// rmigs bu byi ba mchu ring dang*// rta bla bya pho nag po dang*// skyung ka'i khrag dang g.yer ma dang*// bul tog rgya tshwa kha ru tshwa// ti tsha rgyam tshwa tshwa nag dang*// ze tshwa btsan dug thar nu dang*// bse zho thang khrom re lcag pa/

/ra dug gza' dug 'ji dug pa// phag dug khyi spyang byi la'i brun| |mdze pho'i brun ni med thabs med// drod sman gsum dang spang spos dang*// bya phabs mon phabs kong phabs dang*// te lo'i sha dang sgog pa'i rigs// gang byung thams cad bsags pa rnams// zhib btags bong bu'i chu dang sbyar// mdze thod nang blugs ra lpags gtum// de yi phyi la re bas dril// 'dom gang sa yi 'og tu sba| |zhag gsum song nas lang ba'i tshad// lbu ba sob sob khol bar 'gyur// rang srung ra tshil rgya tshil dang*// phag tshil btsan dug ra dug dang*// gza' dug ga pur gla rtsi dang*// shing kun skyung khrag mu zi ser// gzugs mo byi thur rnams zhib btags// tshil dang sbyar ba rang lus kyi// mgo mjug dbang lnga khyab par byug /gong gi rdzas bton grib mar bskam// zhib btags slar yang mdze thod blug /dgos dus skam sbyor gsher sbyor gnyis// skam sbyor dgra la rdzas phye de// me la bsregs sam rlung la bskur// phog ma thag tu shu rgod dang*// rma 'ol phol rdol sha rul nas// gso thabs med par 'chi bar 'gyur// zas la bskyon na smos ci dgos// gsher sbyor bong bu'i chu la sbyar// gdan dang rta sga yob la sogs// sgo them a shing gos dang ni// 'dug sa la sogs gar byugs kyang*// reg pa'i mod la de ma thag /phol mig rdol nas 'chi bar nges// / rdzas kyi khang sel bya ba ni// gri thal gri khrag phung sa dang*// ri rud lha khang mchod rten dang*// thog rgyab sgyogs kyis bshig pa dang*// gle chad gad pa grog stong dang*// mes tshig chus khyer rlung gtor dang*// shwa sbud g.yul bkye grog po dang*// sa g.yos sa rnams gri khrag gis// sbrus pa'i sāts+tsha bzhi btab nas// dgra bo'i sa mkhar rmang phyogs bzhir// sku gdung mgo mjug slog la mnan// zla ba gcig nas mkhar khang de// lcags las grub kyang 'jig par nges// /

zhing sel skye ba rgyun gcod ni// ri bong sngo zan thod pa'i nang*// bya ma byi yi sha khrag spu// byi la'i brun rnams blugs pa'i khar// rta lo pa yi dur gyi rus// bcug la kha bsdams zhing gi dkyil// thong gis mi sleb 'og tu sba// lo gcig song nas skye ba gcod// rdzas yod bar du skye mi srid// rdzas la rdo sgrom bcos byas nas// mi rul lag len gces pa ste// ma rul bar du skye ba 'chad// / zhing la 'bu gtong gdams pa ni// rta pho ngang pa'i rnga ma dag /sor phyed tsam gtub phabs phye dang*// bag phye byang bul tshwa la sbyar// zhing gi rka mgor bskyal ba na// chu yis 'ded tshe zhing kun khyab// drod gsher gyis ni 'bu ru 'gyur// zhing rnams 'joms par gdon mi za// sang zhogs char pa phab pa gces// / zhing la btsa' gtong man ngag ni// bul tog tshwa la mu zi dang*// ldong ros ze tshwa rgya tshwa dang*// gzhan yang tshwa sna kun sbyar ba// btsa' nag lcags btsa' btsa' dmar ni// zangs kyi btsa' la btsa' skya ni// mkhar ba'i btsa' yis kha bsgyur ba// chang sbrus phabs btab zhag gcig bsnyal// phyis nang zhing gi rka mgor blug /chus 'ded tshe na zhing kun khyab// btsa' yis lo tog 'joms par nges// / ser ba dbab pa'i man ngag ni// gri dme mdze yugs bshan pa dang*| |gtsod dang kha sho rabs chad dang*// rta nag khyi nag bong nag dang*// phag nag khrag ste bcu gsum bsag /sdom sdig sbal lcong nya phye leb// rta glang rtsang pa rmigs bu sbrul// sre mo gangs sbal sbur ba'i sha// gu gul mu zi shing kun dang*// btsan dug ra dug thar nu ba// si ta mu la gla rtsi dang*// klu bdud rdo rje go byi la// stag sder rkyang brun dri chen rnams// zhib btags bag phye dang bsres pa// chang sbrus ril bu mtheb tshigs tsam// nam mkha' mi mthong 'khar sder blug /dar nag dag gis kha bkab la// oṃ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sprin bsdus glog 'khyug thog ser phrom ril shal phob khyug khyug breng breng shar shar ser ba phrom ril shar phob/

ces pa 'bum bzlas ril bur gdab// gang dgos yul gyi chu mig ni// byang lta gnyis gsum lnga drug sogs// lo tog rgya dang bstun pa ru// ril bu gsum gsum re bas dril// chu mig phu bcug chu mig der// mkhar gong sgyed steng mdze thod nang*// gong gi sha khrag phye ma rnams// khrag rlon dang sbyar yun ring bskol// mjug tu thab ka chu mig sbub// gzhan yang lo phud sngo thab dang*// dkar gsum sbyar ba'i thab gsur btang*// yul de'i ri rgyud sna mo 'gar// ril bu re re rkyang snang bsreg /yul de'i ser srung liṅga ni// lce phyir drang sogs ngag mnan ni// spyi 'gro lta bu kho rang gi// lha rten 'og tu mnan par bya// rang nyid 'bros shing sngags 'di bgrang*// oṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le ni nā ga rā dza mun ta a// zhes bzlas de ni thog ser sogs// rang phyir mi 'brang gnad zab cing*// 'di ni rdzas 'dzom sngags mang zhing*// lag len gnad theb ma 'phyug na// dgra yul skyin thang bu yug 'tshub// dus ni dbyar ston zla drug las// gzhan du bya min shes par bya// / nye 'byed mkha' lding las sbyor ni// gang dmigs so so'i rus pa ni// bag phye las byas 'greng ba'i tshul// dpon nam bla ma skyes pa sogs// gtso che'i mgo la bya rog gi| |dang ru g.yas gzugs ngar mi la// bya rog sha khrag rta yi rus// sre mo'i khrag dang dmigs bya yi// bdun zur sha khrag gang rnyed bsre// g.yog gam slob ma bud med sogs// dmangs kyi mgo la 'ug pa yi// dang ru g.yon dang 'ug sha khrag /g.yag gi rus pa spu shud khrag /bdun zur sha khrag dag gis sbag /khong par ming rus dmod pa gzhug /ngar mi rgyab sprad rang mdun bzhag /bya rog sgro g.yas 'ug sgro g.yon// rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon thogs// oṃ ka kā shag phye ul+lu ka shag phye/ kha 'ur kha 'ur pa na shag phye/ kha kha 'ur 'ur pa na shag phye/

zhes bzlas brgya phrag re song tshe// ngar mi'i dbus nas sgro gnyis kyis// so sor dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang*// sngags kyis phu gdab dmod pa bor// gsang sngags 'bum phrag thems ma thag /rgyal 'dod ngar mi nyin rir sba// pham 'dod ngar mi srib rir sba// phan tshun ma 'dzol rgyab sprod bya// rang lag sgro gnyis so so'i steng*// rlung gis bskyod par btsugs la bzhag /des ni mthun mdza' gang yin yang*// myur du 'bral bar gdon mi za// / bskrad pa dbyig pa nag po'i las// dgra bo'i zag rdzas kyis sbags pa// liṅga rlung dkyil steng gnas pa// ming rus dmod pas bskor ba la// 'gugs 'dren drag po brgya phrag dang*// oṃ dgra bo che ge mo uts+tsha ta ya yaṃ phaṭa/ ces pa 'bum bzlas liṅgar gdab// phung res dril la sprang dbyig ni// sor bzhi bshags pa'i sbubs su bcug /skar ma bya mchu'i nyi ma la// bya rog mgul btags gzhan du bskrad// lan gsum bskyar bas tshangs pa yang*| |skrod na gzhan la lta ci smos// / rdzas kyi 'gom chog bstan pa ni// dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa dgu'i// chos gos rnam gsum tshal pa dang*// sngags pa dam nus ldan pa dgu'i| |skra sen phreng ba'i dum bu dang*// sku gsung thugs rten rab gnas ni// ldan pa dgu yi bag rdul dang*// dge bshes chos 'chad dgu yi ni// bzhugs khri'i sa dang rgyal po che| |bsod nams ldan dgu'i gos dum dang*// de rnams bsres pa shes rab kyi// snying po phyir kha log bris pas// dril la ri bo 'phan bzang dgu'i// sa la sāts+tsha btab pa'i nang*// rdzas bcug sāts+tsha rab gnas bya// sāts+tsha'i nang du khong rang gi// lha srung ming sngags lha rten gyi// gtor ma bag rdul gzhugs pa gnad// sāts+tshar kho yi lha srung rnams| |bkug la bstims pa grangs mang bya// sāts+tsha re bas dril byas nas// kho yi mal zhabs them 'og gam// rgyu srang sogs su gru gsum du// mgo mjug slog bcug sa yis bkab| |de la dmigs pa'i dgra bo des// lan gcig bgoms pas nus pa nyams// lan gnyis bgoms pas bsod nams 'dzad// lan gsum bgoms pas srog dang 'bral// rang nyid spyod lam gzab par gces// /

rdzas kyi rlung gtad bya ba ni// g.yag rgod rwa g.yas nang du ni// dgra bo'i zag pa btsan dug dang*// bsres pa leb mor byas pa bcug /sdig nag gson po gcig gam gnyis// bcug la g.yag ru re bas dril// chu mig gdol pa gnas nges pa// byang lta'i sngo phug dag tu sba// de tshe sdig pas rdzas zos pas// dgra bo gri 'thab sna dgu po// gang rung gis ni 'gum par nges// / rdzas kyi ltas ngan gtong ba ni// sbrul gyi mig dang spre'u'i snying*// gla ba'i klad pa sre mo'i brun// bya rog 'ug pa'i khrag dang ni// pu shud ze sgro sbal pa'i sha// co ga'i lce dang bong bu'i mje// srin bya'i mchu dang phag gi mchin// gzhan yang srog chags du ma yi// sha rus khrag sogs gang rnyed rnams// bag phye dang sbyar ā tsa ra'am// mon gyi chus sbrus skyo ma la// phabs btab rgya lam sum mdor bsnyal// zhag gsum song nas langs pa na// grib skam phye mar byas pa dag /dgra bo'i khang khyim phyi nang du// btab pas sna tshogs ltas ngan ni// mi rung sna dgu bu yug ltar// 'dus shing 'tshub par gdon mi za// / gzhan yang zhing bcu tshang ba yi// dgra bo sgrol ba'i las sbyor ni// bla sgrub drod rtags thon pa na// bsad zlog 'byed dkrug mnan gtad dang*// thog ser cho 'phrul la sogs pa// gang 'dod gzhan ltar longs spyod pa'i// 'bras rtags myur du 'byung bar 'gyur// de ltar drag po mngon spyod thabs// phal cher rdzas kyis sgrub pa yang*// dus ngan sngags pa rgyud dal gyis// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mi lcogs shing*// blo dman dag gis 'khor lo dang*// sngags kyi gnad la rmongs pa'i phyir// rdzas kyi las sbyor drag po 'di// me bas tsha zhing thog las myur// ral gri phyung rdeg bas kyang rno// de phyir gces par 'dzin pa dang*// dgos dus mkhas pas longs su spyod// rang nyes brtsam las mi bya'o// zhes pa bla sgrub las tshogs kyi// drag po mthu yi las sbyor yang*// 'jig rten gsum mgon bka' ji bzhin// kho bo chos kyi grags pas bris// zhe nag khong khro ma yin yang*// zhing bcu tshang la zhe re tshim//
